book: A specimen of printing types, and ornaments cast in the letter-foundry of George Bruce (1828)
notes: Ninety-one single designs and two three-part compositions. Forty-five distinct designs are supplied by this family, eight further impressions repeat those designs, and forty-four refer to existing collection designs. The cropped long-horn fragment remains partial provenance.
